scope: Fictional offline fixtures only. Final typed source modules; causal regressions are separate from cost samples. No completeness or general loss-rate inference.

base.method: OFF then ON per scenario; four sequential uncertain replays / four batches of four concurrent search clients; 30 fictional 2KB messages; fresh offline daemon each row; first stdout chunk and exit after it measured separately; current exit RSS, CPU includes Node startup and exit instrumentation; hashes exclude random wire id/PID; daemon counters cover its entire lifetime, not only measured commands; unsupported legacy counters omitted; no peak claim; uncontrolled OS cache/order/scheduling; artifacts retained
